title: Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a promising paradigm for code generation, offering the potential for fast, parallel decoding. However, generating complex programs remains challenging, as their interdependent components must maintain consistent interfaces, data flows, and shared assumptions. Aggressive parallel decoding can compromise these dependencies and undermine program correctness, while conservative decoding sacrifices efficiency. To address this trade-off, we propose planning program decomposition before implementation to coordinate interdependent units during parallel generation. We introduce Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code (SDDC), a novel framework that decomposes complex programs and implements their units in parallel, entirely through diffusion. SDDC first generates a contract specifying the program's decomposition and inter-unit dependencies, then uses it to guide coordinated parallel implementation. Acro

translated_title: 面向代码生成的自分解扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型正成为代码生成的一种有前景的范式，具备快速并行解码的潜力。然而，生成复杂程序仍然具有挑战性，因为程序中相互依赖的组件必须保持一致的接口、数据流和共享假设。激进的并行解码可能破坏这些依赖关系并损害程序的正确性，而保守的解码则牺牲了效率。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出在实现之前先规划程序分解，以便在并行生成过程中协调相互依赖的单元。我们提出了面向代码的自分解扩散（SDDC），这是一个新颖的框架，完全通过扩散来分解复杂程序并并行实现其各个单元。SDDC首先生成一个契约，明确规定程序的分解方式及单元间的依赖关系，然后利用该契约指导协调一致的并行实现。
tldr: 提出了SDDC框架，完全通过扩散先生成规定程序分解方式与单元间依赖关系的契约，再据此指导协调的并行实现，从而解决并行解码效率与程序依赖正确性之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: SDDC is a fully diffusion-based framework that first generates a contract specifying program decomposition and inter-unit dependencies, then uses it to guide coordinated parallel implementation, resolving the trade-off between parallel decoding efficiency and program correctness.
